Game Overview

In Intergalactic Battleship, the core idea is straightforward: engage in a cosmic showdown as you outsmart alien forces, strategically locating and destroying enemy ships. Intergalactic Battleship blends timeless board game mechanics with a captivating space theme, delivering immersive strategic battles that are accessible on any device.
